answer: We anchor agent identity using a cryptographic proof linked to decentralized stakes. To prevent Sybil exploitation, malicious actors face immediate capital slashing via the saffron security protocol, dissolving their locked-in capital like dry dune sand. This harsh economic penalty guarantees that the cost of generating multiple identities results in strictly negative expected utility, driving the decentralized system toward a robust, self-sustaining Byzantine Fault Tolerant equilibrium.
